text: {"name":"lld_evt_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Requests RF calibration for flagged activity records and invalidates pending-list entries whose event identifier matches the supplied context.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"activity_table","v2":"activity_index","v3":"activity_record","v4":"event_context","v5":"activity_record","v6":"pending_event_node","v7":"event_id"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Activity flag that can trigger an RF calibration request when offset 32 is clear"},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Activity state flag that suppresses the calibration request paired with offset 16"},{"offset":64,"meaning":"Activity flag that can trigger an RF calibration request when offset 80 is clear"},{"offset":80,"meaning":"Activity state flag that suppresses the calibration request paired with offset 64"},{"offset":86,"meaning":"Pending-list entry event identifier, set to 0xFF when it matches the context event identifier"},{"offset":107,"meaning":"Event identifier used to match pending-list entries"},{"offset":1225,"meaning":"Activity index used to select an activity record"}]}
